# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (May 29, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's focus was on refining upgrade templates for standard chains, with a key bug fix to support `EthLockboxProxy` registration. Additionally, new pull requests were opened to draft U19 upgrade tasks for Mainnet and Sepolia, indicating upcoming network updates.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Upgrade Template Refinements
A critical bug fix was implemented in the `OPCMUpgradeV700` template to properly support standard chains, specifically by registering the `EthLockboxProxy`. This ensures smoother and more accurate upgrade simulations and deployments for various Superchain networks.
- [#1439](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1439)

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#1441](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1441) feat: draft U19 upgrade tasks for Mainnet (053-056): This PR introduces the initial draft of tasks required for the upcoming U19 upgrade on the Mainnet.
- [#1440](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1440) feat: draft U19 upgrade tasks for Sepolia (086-089): This PR outlines the draft tasks for the U19 upgrade specifically for the Sepolia network.

## CLOSED ISSUES
None

## NEW ISSUES
None

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Flaky Test: `TestReorgUnsafeHead`
The `TestReorgUnsafeHead` [#20198](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20198) test continues to be a source of flakiness. A root cause was identified today: the test's reliance on the EL's mutable `eth.Unsafe` label for the "latest" block can lead to reading a stale head under load. This causes the EL to reorg back to the original chain, silently undoing the intended reorg. A fix has been opened in a separate PR [#21112](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21112) which involves polling for the divergence height and using the confirmed conflicting block as the explicit parent, along with generous poll budgets to handle slow-to-canonicalize op-reth instances.

### Interop Proofs Devnet
Progress on the Interop Proofs Devnet [#20489](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20489) is ongoing. Withdrawal finalization is currently a work in progress, with the `op-chain-ops` script for proving withdrawals needing a fix. A withdrawal was initiated last week on `inphi-devnet-0`, and the team is now waiting to prove and finalize it on L1.

### L2CM: Add `setWithdrawalRoute` to FeeVaults
The issue of adding `setWithdrawalRoute` to FeeVaults [#20806](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20806) is currently blocked. A problem has been identified where bumping semvers on L2 contracts causes CI failures. The `TestActivationBlockNUTBundle` test, which uses the `L2Genesis.s.sol` generated state, fails when an L2 contract's semver is bumped because the L2CM code prevents upgrading to a lower semver. This is considered a deficiency in the test rather than a bug in L2CM, and a solution is being sought to address this without halting L2 contract modifications.
